profiles.name: Maya
profiles.bio: Product designer who collects other people's grocery lists. Usually at a gallery, a ceramics class, or hunting down the city's best noodles.

profiles.name: Nora
profiles.bio: Museum curator with a weakness for gift shops and audio guides. I will absolutely make you read the wall text.

profiles.name: Theo
profiles.bio: Architect who draws buildings for a living and cooks elaborate dinners for one. Ask me about the perfect corner window.

profiles.name: Aditya
profiles.bio: Backend engineer who debugs better after a badminton match. Ask me about filter coffee and my mother's biryani.

profiles.name: Aisha
profiles.bio: Marketing by day, aspiring poet by night. I will absolutely drag you to a desert sunrise.

profiles.name: Camille
profiles.bio: Set designer for tiny theatre companies. I collect miniature chairs and strong opinions about croissants.

profiles.name: Noah
profiles.bio: Builds software, breaks bread. Trail runner with a soft spot for old synths and breakfast tacos.

profiles.name: Tobias
profiles.bio: Carpenter, sauna enthusiast, and reluctant ferry commuter. I build things that outlive trends.

profiles.name: Sofia
profiles.bio: Chef, market wanderer, professional snack critic. My love language is a very long lunch.

profiles.name: Mei
profiles.bio: Biomedical student by day, night-market completionist by night. I rank every dumpling I meet.

profiles.name: Elias
profiles.bio: I read too many novels and own too many tote bags. Looking for someone to split a loaf of bread with.

profiles.name: Ibrahim
profiles.bio: Riad gardener and amateur photographer. My love language is a long walk through the medina at golden hour.

profiles.name: Amara
profiles.bio: ER nurse with excellent playlists. Off duty: dance classes, lake swims, and finding the city's best patty.

profiles.name: Freya
profiles.bio: Climate researcher who skis to work when the snow behaves. Looking for someone to share thermos coffee with.

profiles.name: James
profiles.bio: Physio who is very bad at taking his own advice. Beach mornings, dogs, and a flat white.

profiles.name: Diego
profiles.bio: Sound engineer and vinyl digger. I can fix your mix and make a decent empanada, not necessarily in that order.

profiles.name: Priya
profiles.bio: Astronomy PhD student. I'll point out constellations whether you ask or not.

profiles.name: Hana
profiles.bio: Literature student and part-time tea ceremony apprentice. My to-read pile is structurally unsound.

profiles.name: Kai
profiles.bio: I ask too many questions for a living. Climbing, sci-fi, and pour-over coffee on weekends.

profiles.name: Owen
profiles.bio: Pediatric nurse with a stand-up habit. Most of my jokes are about hospital coffee; the coffee deserves it.

profiles.name: Zara
profiles.bio: Junior developer, senior overthinker. Hiking, comedy nights, and a braai with good people.

profiles.name: Sana
profiles.bio: Urban anthropologist mapping street food economies. I'll interview you about your favorite chai stall.

profiles.name: Marcus
profiles.bio: High school history teacher and chess club reluctant advisor. Deep dish is a personality trait.

profiles.name: Lucas
profiles.bio: Junior architect sketching bus stops and beach kiosks. Sunday is for vinyl markets and feijoada.

profiles.name: Layla
profiles.bio: I design bridges and then walk across them for fun. Sea swims, poetry, and feeding everyone.

profiles.name: Ingrid
profiles.bio: Geologist who reads the landscape like a novel. Hot springs are my preferred meeting room.

profiles.name: Leo
profiles.bio: Photographer chasing soft light and good tiles. Will make you stand in front of a wall for 20 minutes.

profiles.name: Tariq
profiles.bio: Product designer, oud player, and hummus purist. I will bring snacks to your gig.

profiles.name: Nia
profiles.bio: Writer of captions, collector of thrifted jackets. Roller skating is my cardio and my personality.

profiles.name: Poppy
profiles.bio: Community radio host and amateur baker. My show is 60% music, 40% me describing what's in the oven.

profiles.name: Sam
profiles.bio: Barista and illustrator. I can draw you, but my latte art is better than my portraits.

profiles.name: Kenji
profiles.bio: Ramen chef who closes the shop and goes record shopping. I believe broth and bass lines need patience.

profiles.name: Olivia
profiles.bio: Urban planner who believes in good bike lanes and better sandwiches. Sea swims year-round.

profiles.name: Marisol
profiles.bio: Marine biologist and salsa dancer. I will point at fish and then make you dance in the kitchen.

profiles.name: Daniel
profiles.bio: Pastry chef, early riser, aggressive croissant advocate. Ask me for dinner recommendations.

profiles.name: Felix
profiles.bio: Philosophy student, chess hustler, and terrible plant dad. My fern and I are both in therapy.

profiles.name: Lina
profiles.bio: Art history student with a museum habit. I will befriend the museum guard so we can stay after closing.

profiles.name: Aaliyah
profiles.bio: Fashion buyer with a soft spot for slow Sundays. I'm happiest at a rooftop with jollof and good company.

profiles.name: Yuki
profiles.bio: Translator, karaoke regular, reluctant morning person. Cats > almost everything.

profiles.name: Rowan
profiles.bio: Glasgow-based illustrator drawing tiny animals in big coats. I'll trade you a portrait for a decent flat white.

profiles.name: Mateo
profiles.bio: Documentary filmmaker with a lot of opinions about street food. Cumbia is always the answer.

profiles.name: Elliot
profiles.bio: Product manager, amateur baker, ferry enthusiast. I plan trips around where I can swim.

profiles.name: Arjun
profiles.bio: Stand-up comic. Most of my material is about my mother, who is also my biggest fan.

profiles.name: Chloe
profiles.bio: Environmental science student. Whale nerd, snowshoe beginner, indie pop enthusiast.

profiles.name: Ben
profiles.bio: Chef with a whisky shelf and a hill-walking habit. I cook, you choose the record.

profiles.name: Grace
profiles.bio: Public health researcher. Yoga before coffee, road trips after. Always planning the next long drive.

profiles.name: Ravi
profiles.bio: Product analyst who takes hawker food extremely seriously. Badminton on Sundays.

profiles.name: Elena
profiles.bio: Architect, ceramicist, and gin-tonic defender. I like buildings with stories and people with them too.

profiles.name: Jae
profiles.bio: Game designer, PC-bang veteran, fried chicken purist. Happiest on a mountain or in a co-op lobby.

profiles.name: Ruby
profiles.bio: Radio producer with a blue hair phase that never ended. Vinyl, cold swims, and comedy gigs.
